dir=\"ltr\" style=\"text-align: left;\" trbidi=\"on\"\u003E\nA 62 year old lady presented to the casualty with sudden onset of shortness of breath since 1 week.\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nHer spo2 was maintaining at room air.\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nThis lady had attained her menarche at 13 years of age. She had obstetric history of P2D2. The 2 deaths were of male babies who had survived for the age of 1year and 2 years respectively with the difference of 3 years between both the deaths. After that she didn't concieve. No history of infertility treatment or OCP usage.\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nThe old lady was apparently symptomatic 3 months back when she developed complaints of increased urinary frequency and burning micturition with white discharge which was mucoid and non foul smelling for 15 days. Also had history of fever which was intermittent in nature for those 15 days.\u0026nbsp; Had given history of pedal edema and facial puffiness intermittently for 1 month. She had thin stream of urine and was diagnosed to be having a structured urethra (opd prescription available mentioning the above)\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nShe had been catheterised.\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nHer USG was suggestive of Thickened bladder wall with trabeculations. Bilateral moderate hydroureteronephrosis with bilateral dilatation of ureter noted up to VUJ. features suggestive of ? Bladder outlet obstruction.\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nUrine culture and sensitivity-\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n2-3 pus cells\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u0026gt;100000 CFU\/ml.\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nE.coli isolated which was only sensitive to Nitrofurantoin.\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n1MONTH LATER URINE C\/S REVEALED\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u0026nbsp;\u0026gt;10 pus cells seen. Escherichia coli \u0026gt;100000 CFU\/ml\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nSensitive to- Piperacillin\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; Gentamicin\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; Cefuroxime\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;Ceftazidime\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;Amikacin\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nSince the past 1 week she had developed fever which was high grade associated with chills. Also gives history of shortness of breath which was insidious in onset and on exertion which gradually progressed to even at rest. Had even complained of decreased urine output since the past one week.\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nGENERAL EXAMINATION\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nPatient is conscious oriented\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nPallor +\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nNo signs of icterus\u003Cbr \/\u003E\ncyanosis\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nClubbing\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nGeneralised lymphadenopathy\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nPedal edema.\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nVITALS\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nBP- 110\/70 mmhg in supine position in right arm\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nPR-90 bpm in right radial artery\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nCVS- S1S2 heard no added sounds\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nR\/s- BAE present.\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nABG\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nPH-7.17\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nPCO2-8.2\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nPo2-148\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nHco3-2.9\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nRFT\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nUrea -184\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nCreatinine -5.5\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nSodium -140\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nPotassium -7.5\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nCBP\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nHb-8.3\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nTLC-18500\u003Cbr \/\u003E\nPLTLTS- 2.51 Lakhs\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr with joint swellings. She states that all her joints we're swollen small and large joints of both the limbs. She had complaints of generalised weakness for the next 3 months. She was married at the age of 13 years. Even till this age she had the previous complaints of joint swellings. Her husband tells that her joints used to swell intermittently whenever she works and that she always was lethargic and weak.\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n4 years back she developed blisters on the arms and legs which were filled with fluid and pruritic.. These lesions were sudden in onset preceeded by burning sensation followed by itching sensation. She also had complaints of generalised weakness so much so that she could not get up. This weakness was associated with tingling sensation of the limbs and spasmodic contractions of the muscles. She was diagnosed to be hypocalcemic and was treated accordingly. The husband gives history of skin biopsy but no documentation could be found. The lesions when she had lasted for 10-15 days and used to occur once every 6 months. No h\/o contact with any thing which could be correlated with the lesions.\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\" style=\"clear: both; text-align: center;\"\u003E\n\u003Ca href=\"https:\/\/blogger.googleusercontent.com\/img\/b\/R29vZ2xl\/AVvXsEiWETNXDmR5tOp1r5Wbl8fDQY5vWdln6vUnh7NG3L27ZF3fHMW7dQ5FvV5I2CfPmh_8eJaWFxfXZ0LJOG1IbhYE1OHAacLwsOnV-CCh6UtuSvCp5oN7RXn3qspFFrgUs77PLaB7oi1L5rjV\/s1600\/IMG_20180302_113331126.jpg\" imageanchor=\"1\" style=\"margin-left: 1em; margin-right: 1em;\"\u003E\u003Cimg border=\"0\" data-original-height=\"1200\" data-original-width=\"1600\" height=\"240\" src=\"https:\/\/blogger.googleusercontent.com\/img\/b\/R29vZ2xl\/AVvXsEiWETNXDmR5tOp1r5Wbl8fDQY5vWdln6vUnh7NG3L27ZF3fHMW7dQ5FvV5I2CfPmh_8eJaWFxfXZ0LJOG1IbhYE1OHAacLwsOnV-CCh6UtuSvCp5oN7RXn3qspFFrgUs77PLaB7oi1L5rjV\/s320\/IMG_20180302_113331126.jpg\" width=\"320\" \/\u003E\u003C\/a\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;This time she has presented with the same complaints of generalised weakness and spasmodic contractions and tingling sensation. dir=\"ltr\" style=\"text-align: left;\" trbidi=\"on\"\u003E\nA lady who was married at the age of 15 years and who conceived 5 children 4 boys and 1 girl, had lost her first 2 children both boys at the age of 6 months to 1 year. Later she lost her husband at the age of 41 years. She was told that her husband had died because of Kidney failure. At the age of 45 she lost her eldest son. She was quiet disturbed with the loss of her husband and eldest son. \u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;She had complaints of dizziness on and off since 4 years, she was diagnosed to be having low Blood pressure and was given salt. 3 years back she had developed a wound on the hand which got infected and then she was diagnosed to be having diabetes mellitus and was started on Glycomet M1. She also had complains of generalised weakness and paraesthesia of all the limbs since 1 year. She had complains of generalised weakness , giddiness , parenthesias on and off. She had a hypoglycaemic episode 6 months back for which her oral hypoglycaemic dose had been changed. \u003Cbr \/\u003E\n\u003Cdiv style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\n\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;Since the past one week she had fever which was high grade associated with chills. The family took her to a local hospital where she was treated and her fever subsided. Later after 2 days she developed loose stools and \u0026nbsp;Vomitings. The stools were watery in consistency, non foul smelling, no h\/o any mucous discharge or blood in the stools. She had almost 10-15 episodes per day for 2days. \u0026nbsp;Vomitings were 5-6 episodes content being food. \u0026nbsp;She was taken to the local hospital where she was put and given iv fluids for 2 days. The son says that she had been on iv fluids for 2 days about 10-15 units of fluids were given per day.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\n\u003Cdiv style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\n\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\n\u003Ch4 style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\n\u0026nbsp;Daughters version\u003C\/h4\u003E\n\u003Cdiv style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\n\u0026nbsp;At around midnight the patient had gone for washroom after which there was a swaying the gait so much that she had to take support of the wall and a bottle which had been put near the foot end of the bed had fell down because of her swaying. She spoke to the attender then she slept. Early in the morning when the patient did not wake up the attenders tried waking her up but she did not get up. She just opened and closed her her eyes intermittently.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\n\u003Cdiv style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\n\u003Ch4 style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\nSon’s version\u003C\/h4\u003E\n\u003Cdiv style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\nAt around midnight the lady had a fall from the bed which she attributed to having a bad dream. The son took her up and then asked whether she hurt herself for which she replied after few minutes. After replying and telling him about the dream she slept. Early in the morning when the patient did not wake up the attenders tried waking her up but she did not get up. She just opened and closed her her eyes intermittently.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\n\u003Cdiv style=\"text-align: left;\"\u003E\n\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\n\u003Cdiv style=\"text-align:
